summary: Magnum Ice Cream Co N.V. filed a Form 6-K containing its half-year results for 2026. The filing reports H1 revenue of €4.7 billion (+4.7% organic growth), adjusted EBIT of €716 million, and reaffirmed full-year outlook. It mentions completed acquisitions in India and Portugal but does not announce any new transaction. This is a routine earnings release, not a special-situation event.
